text:
leo: Heads-up: Vanguard9B-int4 initial bring-up finished. Strong cost wins (roughly 0.26x) but we have a noticeable drop on structured output (JSON/code blocks) and citation chains. Need a short econ + risk brief and a recommended safe rollout for GTN.

anya: Quick infra bench: 235 tok/s/GPU sustained, p95 410ms @1k ctx. Unit cost estimate: ~0.26x vs baseline 13b-int8 (~$17/1M tokens int4 vs $65 baseline).

priya: Eval snapshot (35k mix):
- short-chat: accept -0.3%
- structured-answers (JSON/code blocks): validity-fail +6.1% (fields missing/formatting wrong)
- citation-chains (multi-source): exact-match -2.3%, wrong-source attribution +3.4%
- creative-tone (marketing copy): slight style-shift reported by annotators but not flagged for correctness (~1.0% negative sentiment)

ben: Runtime note: quantized kernels cause more brittle tokenization around code fences, so code block outputs occasionally lose closing backticks or escape characters. That maps to the structured-answers failures. KV cache looks fine for short-turn chat.

leo: Mini-scorecard we can show PMs:
```
Model: Vanguard9B-int4
Slices: short-chat | structured-answers | citation-chain | creative-copy
Quality delta vs baseline: -0.3% | -6.1% | -2.3% | -1.0%
Latency p95 (1k ctx): 410ms | 520ms | 480ms | 400ms
Unit-cost: 0.26x baseline
Product-risk: Low | High | Medium | Low-Medium
```

sam: Product asks: if we route 30% traffic, and structured-answers are 4% of requests, how many extra invalids do we expect? Need per-1k and per-day numbers.

priya: Back-of-envelope calc: extra_invalids_abs = routing_pct * fail_rate * slice_share = 0.3 * 0.061 * 0.04 = 0.000732 -> 0.0732% absolute increase overall -> ~0.732 invalids per 1k requests. For 1M requests/day that's ~732 extra invalids/day. We'll show both.

anya: Cost upside headline: ~74% per-token savings. Example: 90k DAU * 900 tokens/day -> ~60M tokens/day saved -> ~$1.0k/day at L0 rates.

ben: Quick mitigations we can ship before wide rollout:
- post-process validator for structured-answers that checks JSON/code fences and triggers immediate reroute to baseline if invalid
- citation re-ranking: if top-2 sources disagree or source-confidence low -> fallback to baseline
- small tokenizer-patch to preserve fence tokens in quant path (low-risk patch)

leo: Proposed conservative rollout for GTN:
1) Canary 4% total traffic; allowlist slices: short-chat, creative-copy.
2) Shadow 40% of structured-answers and citation-chain traffic for 72h with high-priority human checks.
3) Holdback structured-answers at 90% until validator + tokenizer patch reduce invalids below 1.5%.
4) Auto-fallback rule: structured-validator fail OR citation_confidence < 0.6 -> route to baseline.

priya: Ops config snippet (copyable):
```
canary:
  percent: 4
  allowed_slices: [short-chat, creative-copy]
shadow:
  percent: 40
  slices: [structured-answers, citation-chain]
fallback_policy:
  structured_validator: true
  citation_confidence_threshold: 0.6
  fallback_model: baseline-13b-int8
monitoring:
  structured_invalid_alert: 1.5%_1h
  citation_misattr_alert: 2%_4h
```

nanya: One-line recommendation for GTN: "Vanguard9B-int4 offers ~74% per-token cost savings; safe for chat and creative copy with canary, but hold back structured outputs and citation-heavy flows behind shadowing and validators until fixes reduce invalids to <1.5%."

ben: I'll open the tokenizer patch PR and the structured-validator job. ops-bot, can you create the canary cluster?

ops-bot: Canary cluster request accepted: canary-vanguard9b-2026-03-23 queued. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/vanguard9b-canary

leo: Can someone make a one-slide TL;DR (scorecard + rollout + per-1k counts) for PMs by EOD? PMs want short math and the fallback rule verbatim.

priya: I'll put together the slide and include CSV snippets for the eval slices. Ping me for raw rows. :thumbsup:
